home.hero_eyebrow: Merchant exporter of dehydrated foods · India
home.hero_tagline: India's Harvest, Preserved for the World.
home.hero_sub: We take freshly harvested Indian produce and turn it into shelf-stable flakes, granules and powders that travel well. Food manufacturers, flavour houses and distributors around the world rely on us for steady supply and consistent quality.
home.products_heading: Powders and ingredients for every formulation
home.products_sub: Indian-grown produce, dried and milled into clean powders and food-grade ingredients. Each grade is made for long shelf life, true flavour and reliable performance in your recipes.
home.card1_desc: Leaves and herbs such as moringa, curry leaf and spinach, dried gently and milled into clean, deep-green powders for teas, supplements and seasoning.
home.card2_title: Dehydrated Vegetable Powders – Culinary & Spice Applications
home.card2_desc: Onion, garlic, tomato and chilli powders that carry real flavour into kitchens, ready blends and savoury mixes.
home.card3_desc: Beetroot, carrot, pumpkin and spinach powders chosen for natural colour, fibre and the nutrients buyers look for.
home.card4_desc: Mango, banana, pineapple and berry powders made for bakery, cereal, dairy and beverage recipes.
home.card5_desc: Guar gum, gum acacia and related additives that bring texture, binding and stability to your formulations.
home.card6_desc: Private-label blends and made-to-spec grades, built around your recipe and packed to your brief.
home.why_dehydrated_sub: Take out the water and you keep the goodness while cutting the cost and hassle of moving it.
home.why_d_shelf_body: 12 to 24 months with no cold chain.
home.why_d_colour_body: Same flavour and colour each batch.
home.industries_sub: We supply dehydrated ingredients to businesses that build flavour into their products:
home.industries_body: Our role is to support these industries with reliable, food-grade ingredients that add real value to their end products.
home.edge_c1_body: From FSSAI and ISO 22000 to HACCP and APEDA, every consignment ships with the certifications and paperwork your market expects.
home.edge_c2_body: We buy straight from India's growers and audited processing units, so there are no middlemen and quality stays traceable from farm to pack.
home.edge_c3_body: Strategic port access, dependable freight partners and export-grade packaging keep every shipment safe and on schedule, worldwide.
home.edge_c4_body: Every lot carries a code you can follow from raw material to dispatch, which keeps audits and recalls straightforward.
home.edge_c5_body: Straight answers, clear pricing and ethical trade on every order. No fine print, no surprises.
home.edge_c6_body: We would rather earn a long partnership than win a single order, so we invest in trust and steady growth.
home.quality_sub: Every lot is made in hygienic, certified facilities under tight quality control. We grade the raw material, test moisture and microbial counts, run metal detection, then do a final check before it leaves for dispatch.
home.quality_step1_body: Incoming produce is sorted and graded the moment it arrives.
home.quality_step2_body: Each lot is tested against spec before it moves to processing.
home.quality_step3_body: Every batch runs through a metal detector, no exceptions.
home.quality_step4_body: Signed off, then sealed and packed ready for export.
home.markets_sub: From the US and UK to Europe, the Gulf and Australia, Clarté Overseas supplies importers, processors and distributors across five continents, and the map keeps growing.
home.working_sub: From a first trial order to repeat container loads, we keep things flexible, clear and ready for export.

home.working_c3_body: Your brand and your spec, packed to retail or bulk format.
home.working_c4_body: Quick turnaround from confirmed order to goods on the dock.
home.working_c5_body: Dependable freight partners for reliable, on-time global delivery.
home.working_c6_body: Invoice, packing list, COO and certificates handled end-to-end.

about.hero_heading: Bringing India's harvest to the world's food businesses
about.hero_sub: Clarté Overseas is a New Delhi based merchant exporter of dehydrated fruits, vegetables and food-grade ingredients. We help food brands, manufacturers and distributors source from India without the usual friction.
about.who_body1: We started Clarté Overseas in 2025 with one clear aim: make it easy for food businesses anywhere to buy dependable dehydrated ingredients from India. The country grows an extraordinary range of produce and botanicals, yet for an overseas buyer, finding a supplier who is consistent, compliant and genuinely easy to deal with is still surprisingly hard. Closing that gap is the whole reason we exist.
about.who_body2: We are a merchant exporter, not a single factory. We work with a vetted network of manufacturers and processors across the country, which lets us offer a broad range of grades and forms while keeping a close watch on quality, documentation and delivery. From raw-material selection and lab testing to packaging and export paperwork, every shipment is handled with the same care, whether it is a first trial order or a repeat container.
about.who_body3: The way we work comes down to three habits: clarity in how we communicate, compliance with the standards each market expects, and consistency you can plan your own production around.
about.purpose_heading: Building the world's go-to ingredient partner
about.purpose_sub: We are not here just to fill orders. We are building Clarté Overseas into a name food businesses anywhere can source from with complete confidence.
about.mission_body: Give food brands and manufacturers a dehydrated-ingredient partner they can fully rely on: steady quality, honest sourcing, and supply that lands on time, every single order.
about.vision_body: Become the world's largest and most trusted exporter of dehydrated food ingredients, reaching buyers in as many countries as we possibly can.
about.goal1_body: Serve buyers on every continent, then keep widening the map year on year.
about.goal2_body: Be the supplier our customers never have to chase, shipment after shipment.
about.goal3_body: Full traceability and fair, sustainable sourcing, from the farm to the port.
about.goal4_body: Capacity, systems and certifications that grow as fast as demand does.
about.markets_body: We already work with buyers across the UK, Europe, the Gulf and Australia, and we're actively opening up more. Here is where we're focused next.
about.values_sub: The way we like to work
about.val1_body: The same spec, batch after batch, so your line never has to adjust.
about.val2_body: Documentation and standards matched to each market you sell into.
about.val3_body: Clear pricing, clear timelines, and updates you do not have to ask for.
about.val4_body: We build the grade, form and pack around your recipe, not ours.
about.val5_body: A vetted network and planning that keeps repeat orders steady.
about.val6_body: We would rather grow with you than win a one-off order.
about.partners_body: If you source, distribute, manufacture or open markets in food ingredients, there is a way to work together.
about.faq_sub: A few things buyers often want to know before getting in touch.
about.faq1_a: We are based in New Delhi, India, and ship to buyers around the world. Working from a major trade and logistics hub keeps documentation, freight and coordination straightforward.
about.faq2_q: Are you a manufacturer or an exporter?
about.faq2_a: We are a merchant exporter. Rather than running a single factory, we work with a vetted network of manufacturers and processors across India, which lets us offer a wide range of grades and forms while keeping a close watch on quality and paperwork.
about.faq3_q: How long have you been in business?
about.faq3_a: Clarté Overseas was established in 2025. We are a young, focused company built specifically around making dehydrated-ingredient sourcing from India simple and dependable for overseas buyers.
about.faq4_q: What makes you different from other exporters?
about.faq4_a: Consolidated sourcing across several ingredient categories, quality control and lab testing on every lot, full batch traceability, transparent communication, and a genuine preference for long-term partnerships over one-off orders.
about.faq5_q: Do you only work with large buyers?
about.faq5_a: Not at all. We keep MOQs trial-friendly so smaller importers, manufacturers and private-label brands can start with a test order and scale as the relationship grows.
about.faq6_q: What registrations and certifications do you hold?
about.faq6_a: We are GST, IEC and RCMC registered, with FSSAI and ISO 9001 in place, and we provide complete export documentation with every shipment.
about.faq7_q: How do we start working together?
about.faq7_a: Tell us the product, the form and your target market through the quote form or WhatsApp. We will come back with specifications, samples where helpful, and a quote in your currency.
about.cta_sub: Tell us your requirement and target market. We'll reply with specs, samples and a quote in your currency.
export.hero_heading: How your order travels from India to your port
export.hero_sub: No black boxes. Here is the route every Clarté Overseas shipment follows — from the field it is sourced in to the vessel it sails on, and the support that carries on long after it lands.
export.journey_sub: Scroll down and the road draws itself. Each stop lights up as your shipment reaches it.
export.journey_s1_body: It starts upstream. We map your requirement to a vetted network of growers, processors and manufacturers across India, choosing each source for the crop belt, capability and track record behind it.
export.journey_s2_body: Specs before stock. We buy to your grade, mesh, moisture, pack size and volume — confirming the brief, samples and timeline first, so what we procure is what you actually need.
export.journey_s3_body: Nothing moves until it passes. Every lot is graded and lab-checked — moisture, microbial counts, foreign matter, metal detection — with documentation matched to the rules of the market you sell into.
export.journey_s4_body: Food-grade liners, sturdy export cartons or bags, clear lot marking and proper palletisation — packaging built for long ocean transits and easy handling at your warehouse.
export.journey_s5_body: Commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, phytosanitary and lab certificates — prepared accurately and on time so your consignment moves without hold-ups.
export.journey_s6_body: Container booking, supervised stuffing and dispatch on the Incoterms we've agreed — with tracking shared so you always know where your goods are on the water.
export.journey_s7_body: The container sails and it feels like the deal is done. For us, that's where the relationship really begins — we track it to your door, help with any clearance query, check the product landed right, and get your next order moving.
export.aftercare_body: A lot of exporters wave goodbye at the port. We see the loaded container as a beginning — because the next order, and the one after that, are built on how we show up after this one lands.
export.incoterms_sub: Pick a term and see exactly how far we carry the shipment — and where you take over.
export.payment_sub: A few small things that make paying — and getting paid — straightforward on both sides.
export.pay_proforma_desc: Every order opens with a clear proforma invoice — quantity, grade, price and terms set out in writing, before anything moves.
export.pay_costs_desc: FOB or CIF, broken down line by line — you see exactly what each part costs, with nothing hidden.
export.pay_tt_desc: A telegraphic-transfer deposit confirms your order and books production.
export.pay_lc_desc: Irrevocable letters of credit for larger or first-time contracts.
export.pay_flex_desc: Balance against a copy of the bill of lading, and other terms we tune for repeat buyers.
export.sustain_sub: Exporting well isn't only about speed and price. A few principles we hold to from field to port.
export.sustain_s1_body: We favour growers and processors who treat land and labour fairly.
export.sustain_s2_body: Right-sized, food-grade packing that protects product without excess.
export.sustain_s3_body: Consolidated, well-planned shipments that cut empty miles and emissions.
export.faq_sub: The practical questions buyers ask before the first shipment.
export.faq1_q: What is your minimum order quantity?
export.faq1_a: It depends on the product and packing, but we keep MOQs trial-friendly so first-time buyers can start with a test order and scale once the relationship is working. Tell us the item and target volume and we'll confirm what's workable.
export.faq2_q: Can I order a sample before placing a full order?
export.faq2_a: Yes. For most products we can arrange representative samples so you can check the grade, colour, mesh and aroma against your spec before committing to a shipment.
export.faq3_q: Which Incoterms do you work with?
export.faq3_a: Commonly EXW, FOB, CFR and CIF. FOB is what most of our buyers choose, but if you'd rather we book and pay the freight (and insurance), CFR or CIF work just as well. The Incoterms section above shows exactly how far we cover under each.
export.faq4_q: How long does a typical shipment take?
export.faq4_a: Production and pre-shipment checks usually take a couple of weeks after the order is confirmed, then ocean transit depends on your destination port. We share an indicative timeline with your quote and keep you posted as dates firm up.
export.faq5_q: What payment terms do you accept?
export.faq5_a: Every order starts with a proforma invoice. We typically work on an advance T/T deposit with the balance against a copy of the bill of lading, and we accept irrevocable letters of credit at sight for larger or first-time contracts. Terms are flexible for repeat buyers.
export.faq6_q: Which documents come with my consignment?
export.faq6_a: A standard set includes the commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin, along with the product specification, lab/analysis reports and any market-specific certificates your importer requires.
export.faq7_q: Can you handle packaging and private labelling to our spec?
export.faq7_a: Yes. We supply food-grade bulk packing as standard and can arrange custom pack sizes, retail packaging and private-label branding when you need it — just share the brief.
export.faq8_q: What happens after my goods are shipped?
export.faq8_a: We don't disappear at the port. We track the shipment to your door, help with any clearance query, check the product landed as expected, and stay on hand to plan your next order. The relationship is the point.
export.cta_sub: Tell us the product, the form and your destination. We'll map the route, the terms and a quote — and stay with you the whole way.
cert.hero_heading: Credentials you can open, read and verify
cert.hero_sub: We would rather show our paperwork than talk about it. Every registration and licence below is held in Clarté Overseas's own name — download the actual certificate and check it for yourself.
cert.our_sub: Hover a card to inspect it, then download the certificate. These are the documents that let us trade and that buyers ask for first.
cert.cred1_authority: Food Safety & Standards Authority of India
cert.cred1_desc: Our Central FSSAI licence certifies that Clarté Overseas operates within India's food-safety law as a trader and exporter of food products — your assurance that everything we handle is managed to regulation.
cert.cred2_desc: The Importer-Exporter Code is the licence that authorises us to move goods across India's borders. No consignment leaves the country without it — and ours is active and in our own name.
cert.cred3_authority: Agricultural & Processed Food Products Export Dev. Authority
cert.cred3_desc: Registration with APEDA, and the Registration-cum-Membership Certificate it carries, marks us as a recognised exporter of agricultural and processed food products across all of our ingredient categories.
cert.cred4_desc: ISO 9001:2015 certification shows our quality-management system is documented, audited and built for consistency — the same disciplined process that sits behind every single order.
cert.cred5_desc: Our Goods & Services Tax registration confirms Clarté Overseas as a compliant, tax-registered business entity in India — the baseline every legitimate exporter is expected to hold.
cert.cred6_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
cert.cred6_desc: Our Udyam registration recognises Clarté Overseas under India's MSME framework, supporting priority access to trade-facilitation and finance schemes for growing exporters.
cert.file_note: Files open in a new tab. Need a stamped or more recent copy for your records? Just ask.
cert.partner_heading: Standards held by our partner facilities
cert.partner_sub: Beyond our own licences, the manufacturers we work with operate to internationally recognised food-safety standards. Open a panel to see what each one means.
cert.std1_desc: A food-safety management standard that layers HACCP principles over a full management system — applied at the facilities that process our ingredients.
cert.std2_desc: Hazard Analysis & Critical Control Points: the preventive framework that identifies and controls food-safety risks at each step of processing.
cert.std3_desc: A GFSI-recognised global standard for food safety and quality, widely required by retailers and brand owners across Europe and beyond.
cert.std4_desc: Partner facilities supplying US-bound product maintain US FDA food-facility registration, as required for import into the United States.
cert.std5_desc: Halal certification at partner units for buyers serving Muslim-majority markets and communities — arranged per requirement.
cert.std6_desc: Kosher certification available through partner facilities for buyers with kosher supply requirements in their market.
cert.std_note: These certifications are maintained by our vetted manufacturing partners and apply at the facility level. We confirm and arrange the exact certification your order and market require — facility certificates are shared on request.
cert.faq_sub: The questions buyers ask most when they check who they are dealing with.
cert.faq1_q: Can I see your certificates before placing an order?
cert.faq1_a: Yes. Every company credential on this page can be downloaded directly — the files are the actual certificates issued in Clarté Overseas's name. We are also happy to share fresh copies or answer specific compliance questions over email or WhatsApp.
cert.faq2_q: Are these registrations held in the company's own name?
cert.faq2_a: They are. GST, IEC, Udyam (MSME), FSSAI, APEDA and ISO 9001:2015 are all registered to Clarté Overseas — not borrowed from a third party. The downloadable copies show exactly that.
cert.faq3_q: Do your products carry food-safety certification?
cert.faq3_a: We hold a Central FSSAI licence as a food exporter, and the manufacturing facilities we work with operate to recognised standards such as ISO 22000, HACCP and BRCGS. Facility-level certificates can be provided per order on request.
cert.faq4_q: Can you supply Halal or Kosher certified product?
cert.faq4_a: Yes, through partner facilities that hold the relevant certification. Tell us the product, your market and the certifying body you need, and we will confirm availability before you commit.
cert.faq5_q: What documents ship with my order?
cert.faq5_a: A typical export set includes the commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin, along with the product specification, lab/analysis reports and any market-specific certificates your importer requires.
cert.faq6_q: Can you meet a specific importing country's certification requirement?
cert.faq6_a: Often, yes. Share the destination country and the requirement, and we will tell you what is feasible, what documentation is involved and how we would arrange it through our network.
cert.faq7_q: Is your quality system independently audited?
cert.faq7_a: Yes. We run an ISO 9001:2015 quality-management system and carry out quality control and lab testing on every lot, with full batch traceability from source to dispatch.
cert.cta_sub: Tell us what you need and where it is headed. We'll reply with specs, samples and the certificates your market calls for.
contact.hero_sub: Whether you have a specific product in mind or just want to explore what we can supply, we're here to help.
contact.talk_sub: Reach us however suits you. We typically respond within a few hours during business hours.
contact.success_body: We've received your enquiry and will get back to you within 24 hours.
products.hero_heading: Dehydrated powders, milled for the world's food makers
products.hero_sub: Five focused categories, each grown and processed in India for clean flavour, true colour and dependable, spec-driven supply. Pick a category to see the full range.
products.cat_herbal_leaf_powders_desc: Leaves and herbs grown across India, dried low and slow to protect their deep green colour and natural actives, then milled into clean, even powders for supplements, functional foods and seasonings.
products.cat_culinary_spice_powders_desc: Onion, garlic, ginger and chilli — the workhorses of kitchens and food plants worldwide. Consistent pungency, clean flavour and a full range of cuts, from fine powder to kibbled flakes.
products.cat_functional_nutritional_powd: Beetroot, tomato, carrot, lemon and more — vegetable and fruit powders chosen for natural colour, nutrition and clean-label functionality in supplements, seasonings, soups and ready meals.
products.cat_fruit_powders_desc: Single-origin Indian fruits, gently dried and milled into free-flowing powders that hold their colour, tang and natural sweetness — built for beverages, bakery, dairy, confectionery and nutraceuticals.
products.cat_hydrocolloids_food_additive: India is the world's hub for plant-based gums and fibres. We supply guar gum, psyllium, tamarind kernel and cassia derivatives for food, beverage, pharma and industrial applications.

blog.faq_sub: The things importers and manufacturers most often want to know before they get in touch.
blog.faq1_q: What products does Clarté Overseas export?
blog.faq1_a: Dehydrated fruits and vegetables in flake and powder form, herbal and leaf powders, culinary and spice powders, functional and nutritional powders, fruit powder ingredients, and hydrocolloids and food additives.
blog.faq2_q: Do you send samples before a bulk order?
blog.faq2_a: Yes. We encourage a trial order or samples so you can test the product, the documentation and our communication on a small volume before committing to a container.
blog.faq3_q: What forms and grades can you supply?
blog.faq3_a: Flakes, granules and fine powders, with custom mesh sizes and specs built around your formulation. If you are unsure which form suits your product, we are happy to advise.
blog.faq4_a: We work with buyers across the UK, Europe, the Gulf and Australia, and we are actively opening up more markets across the world.
blog.faq5_q: What certifications and documentation do you provide?
blog.faq5_a: We are GST, IEC and RCMC registered, with FSSAI and ISO 9001 in place, and we handle full export documentation including the commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin.
blog.faq6_q: What about minimum order quantities and lead times?
blog.faq6_a: We keep MOQs trial-friendly so you can start small, with a typical despatch window of two to four weeks from a confirmed order. Private label and custom packaging are available on request.
